::: {.callout-warning appearance="simple"}
**Single-year evaluation window.** WW3 RUN_02, the configuration with one-way
coupling to CROCO surface currents and water levels, was run for January–December
2016 only. The skill statistics in this chapter are therefore based on
approximately one year of co-located satellite data. A multi-year coupled
hindcast — extending RUN_02 to match the multi-year CROCO record — is the
headline upgrade planned for the next release of this report (see
@sec-roadmap).
:::
